messages:
deploy-bot: NOTICE: Completed change window for eu-west-1 runtime pool. Applied kernel security backports + pinned model variants for fallback. Summary: 21:00-21:18 UTC; no automatic rollbacks triggered. ops-ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5312
marie: Thanks — quick thread to draft the customer-facing status update? I can post to Statuspage and email digest. Need short blurb + impact window + recovery steps.
rick: From eng-oncall: we did a limited pin to v1.4.2 for the quantized variants and left canary traffic on v1.5.0. Latency spike observed at 21:06 for ~4min, error rate peaked 1.8% -> auto-fallback engaged. All fallbacks behaved as expected.
priya: Can we confirm which customers were on dedicated pools vs hosted so we can segment notices? Need a CSV by EOD to attach to the email.
luis: Product ops here — drafting the statuspage snippet. Proposal: 
```
Status: Partial disruption resolved
Affected services: Hosted inference (eu-west-1)
Window: 2026-03-19 21:00–21:18 UTC
Impact: Brief increase in request errors and elevated latency for some customers; automatic fallbacks reduced user-visible failures.
Customer action: No action required. If you saw degraded responses after 21:06, please retry; open a support ticket if problems persist.
```
Would like language edited for legal/PR.
anita: Suggest removing the phrase "user-visible" and add "we recommend retrying requests". Also: add link to postmortem-to-be and contact for SLA credits. Example line: "If your application experienced persistent errors, contact support to review SLA eligibility."
marie: Good call. Also can we include the changelog bullet for transparency: "kernel backports, forced model variant pin to v1.4.2 for quantized models, telemetry agent bump" — short list only.
rick: Confirming changelog accuracy. Also note rollback trigger thresholds used: 3% sustained error rate over 2 minutes OR 40% p95 latency regression — both were watched but not met. We had manual hold at 21:12 while traces were inspected.
luis: Ok combining edits. Draft for statuspage + email subject lines:
- Statuspage headline: "Resolved: eu-west-1 inference disruption (post-maintenance)"
- Email subject: "Redwood: brief eu-west-1 maintenance caused transient errors — resolved"
Marie's copy will include the support contact and link to support form.
priya: CSV request: ops, can you add a column for tier (hosted/dedicated/private) + contact email? We'll send segmented templates.
deploy-bot: ops-note: pinned model=quant-v1.4.2; fallback used=quant-v1.5.0->quant-v1.4.2; telemetry-roll=2.1.3; ops-ticket=OPS-5312
marie: I'll post the statuspage now, then push the HQ email with the segmented templates. Posting snippet below for final approval before publish: 
"At ~21:06 UTC on 2026-03-19, customers in eu-west-1 may have experienced brief elevated latency and a small number of request errors following a scheduled kernel backport and model pin. Automatic fallbacks reduced customer impact and the issue was resolved within 18 minutes. No action is required. If you continue to see errors, please open a support ticket: https://redwood.com/support."
luis: Approved from product.
anita: Approved from legal with the SLA sentence added: "If your application experienced persistent errors, contact support to review SLA eligibility."
rick: Ops+eng approve. Marking this thread resolved. If any customer reports or partner asks for a postmortem earlier, I'll prepare a short blameless timeline.
marie: Posting now :white_check_mark: I'll also attach the changelog snippet and include the dedicated-customer CSV as an attachment in the email. Closing thread after publish. :rocket:
